newsitem.title: DUBAI: Oman stocks rise 1.4 percent in week's trade.
newsitem.headline: Oman stocks rise 1.4 percent in week's trade.

text.p: Shares on the Oman stock exchange rose 1.4 percent in the week to Wednesday with banks and financial blue chips leading trade.
The Muscat Securities Market said the index climbed to 280.85 points from 276.85 points the previous week.

The total value of trade was down at 16.74 million rials ($44 million) from 17.52 million rials the week earlier. But turnover rose, with 8.72 million shares traded up on 5.74 million shares the previous week.
The exchange said banking and financial stocks continued to dominate the market, accounting for 71 percent of trade.
Dhofar International Development was among the most active stocks, with 739,000 shares worth 2.5 million rials changing hands. The stock gained, closing at 3.420 rials from 2.960 rials.
Oman and Emirates Investment gained 80 baisa closing at 3.040 rials and Oman Cement closed at 3.730, adding 230 baisa despite announcing slightly lower 1996 net profit.
Of the 74 shares traded in the week, 32 rose, 21 dipped and 21 were unchanged.
